# artifact-helper plugin

This branch holds only the artifact-helper plugin for Claude Code: its manifest, MCP server entry, skill and session hook. A release job publishes it from [main](https://github.com/tyrantkhan/artifact-helper) at each release and replaces everything here, so changes MUST go to main.

The plugin needs the `artifact-helper` command on your PATH, and Claude Code signed in to a Claude subscription. Install the command as [the README on main](https://github.com/tyrantkhan/artifact-helper#install) describes.
